No High contrast colour can fail the placeholder half alone: on a step-3 RGB grid (636,056 colours; 113,934 reach 3:1 and sit 30 from the felt), the closest of those to #c23b8f is 24.87, so this family's control here is the roster half; the placeholder half's is unstyled-placeholder-moves-onto-an-owner-colour, which moves the placeholder instead. Measured with colour-distance.ts on 2026-10-10 (origin/main c200cf62 plus issue #1056).
